data.name: Perceptum
data.detailed_description:
Perceptum is an independent psychological horror game lasting around 4-5 hours, focused on discomfort, uncertainty, and the feeling that something is always just out of sight. You play as a medium searching for a family that mysteriously vanished shortly after moving into their new home. Inside the house, familiar spaces feel wrong, silence becomes oppressive, and your senses cannot be trusted. Walk through the odd halls of the house, close your eyes to hear the beyond, use your mirror to see the unseen, and uncover the truth hidden within these walls.

Your Objective

An entire family vanished without a trace. The police eventually abandoned the case. Now, you are the last hope to uncover the truth. As a medium, you must step inside the house and piece together what truly happened. Search for clues, solve puzzles, and let your senses guide you through this linear horror experience.

Gameplay Experience

Your only weapons are a mirror and the ability to close your eyes. Your mirror reveals what cannot be seen with the naked eye, exposing hidden traces and disturbing reflections. Closing your eyes leaves you vulnerable, forcing you to rely on altered sounds and distant whispers to find your way. As you explore the house, curiosity and unease grow side by side. The atmosphere is oppressive, and the feeling of being watched never fully fades.

Tension runs throughout the experience, shifting between quiet oppression and intense moments of fear. The house reacts to your presence, and the mirror remains both a tool and a threat. When something finally reveals itself, there is no way to fight back.

Trust your instincts: if you think you saw or heard something, you probably did. Stay calm, pay attention to every detail. You might not be alone.

data.short_description: A psychological horror game where you play as a medium investigating the disappearance of a family. Explore a house with an oppressive atmosphere, close your eyes to hear the beyond, use your mirror to see what should not exist and uncover the truth hidden within its walls.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Turkish, German

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64 Bits
  • Processor: Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 from 2016
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Audio headphone / Audio speaker
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 - 64 Bits
  • Processor: Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 7 from 2018
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Audio headphone

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains scenes of intense horror, psychological tension, and disturbing or unsettling imagery. It may include sudden jumpscares, loud or unexpected audio cues, and themes that some players may find distressing.

This game also features flashing lights, high-contrast visual effects, and rapidly changing images that may trigger seizures or other symptoms in individuals with photosensitive epilepsy. If you or any member of your family has a history of epilepsy or related conditions, consult a doctor before playing.

Discontinue playing immediately if you experience dizziness, nausea, eye strain, loss of awareness, or any other discomfort.
